title: Didn't last a year
text: Didn't last a year. I was not impressed, this didn't last even a year, I did put it through it's paces as we drink a lot of coffee.

product_metadata.title: Black & Decker 4 Cup Coffee Maker, 4, Black
features: Grab-A-Cup Auto Pause stops cycle if you need a cup before brewing is finished
Dual water window allows visibility as you fill—no more overflows
Removable filter basket for quick and easy cleanup
Stain-resistant warming plate is easy to clean.
description: Helps you make rich-tasting, expertly brewed coffee without stress or mess. Should you need a cup before the brew cycle is finished, Grab-A-Cup Auto Pause is a lifesaver. It stops brewing so you can pour freely, and then finishes the brewing cycle after you place the carafe back in position. It also features a removable basket filter that lifts out for quick and easy filling and cleaning. Whether you want a single cup or 4.
